schema.name: Our Team
schema.description: Meet the talented team at Rainscope Filmworks. Our experienced filmmakers, directors, and creative professionals bring your vision to life.

cta.text: Ready to start your project with our team?
cta.label: Contact Us

members.name: Jackson Lee
members.title: Co-Owner
members.bio: Jackson brings creative vision and strategic leadership to every project. With a passion for storytelling and deep understanding of the Pacific Northwest film industry, he ensures every production meets the highest standards of quality and creativity.

members.name: Cristian Oriak
members.title: Co-Owner
members.bio: Cristian is a master of visual storytelling, bringing cinematic quality to every frame. His expertise in lighting, composition, and camera movement creates visually stunning narratives that captivate audiences.

members.name: Lava Sood
members.title: Director Of Post And Photography
members.bio: Lava transforms raw footage into polished masterpieces through expert editing, color grading, and post-production techniques. With an eye for detail and creative flair, every project receives the finishing touches it deserves.

members.name: Hans Potter
members.title: Sales
members.bio: Hans connects clients with the perfect production solutions, ensuring smooth communication and seamless project coordination from initial inquiry to final delivery.

members.name: Malka Martz-Oberlander
members.title: Social Media Strategist
members.bio: Malka manages our social media presence, creating engaging content and building strong connections with our audience across all platforms.
